explication: RustDesk Server is a self-hosted remote-access backend, with separate rendezvous/ID and relay executables plus an optional Windows desktop manager. The main workflow registers peers with hbbs, retains peer identity/state, and supports rendezvous coordination; clients may use the separately operated relay service. The manager provides service controls and log/config viewing. Source excerpts establish hbbs dispatch, peer persistence, and parts of the UI; relay internals and several UI event links are not fully shown, so those connections are omitted.
